lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah to tell the covenant's words to the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.
God commanded the covenant to the forefathers when He brought them out of Egypt, the iron furnace.
God swore an oath to give the forefathers a land flowing with oil and honey, and Jeremiah answered, "Amen, LORD."
The house of Israel and the house of Judah broke the covenant, and will cry out to gods.
The LORD called them a flourishing olive tree, but He will set it on fire for burning incense to Asherah.
